DESCRIPTION: This screenshot displays the ElevenLabs admin dashboard with a dark-themed sidebar and a main content area titled "Branches." The sidebar includes navigation for Overview, Configure (Agent, Procedures, Workflow, Branches, Knowledge Base), and Monitor sections. The main view shows a table listing agent branches with columns for Name, Traffic Split, Conversations, Status, and metadata, along with a "Create branch" button and top-bar options like "Preview" and "Publish."

APP: ElevenLabs admin dashboard
SCREEN: Branches (Agent Configuration)
